have never experienced such an unprofessional and shocking service from any GP practice in my life. Little Town Medical Practice is an absolute joke.

We booked an appointment and had to wait three weeks just to be seen – that alone is ridiculous. When I finally arrived for my appointment, I signed in and waited 40–50 minutes past the scheduled time. I became impatient because the appointment time had clearly passed. I asked the receptionist, who told me to “wait another 5–10 minutes and the doctor will see you soon.”

After waiting another 10 minutes, she then told me I needed to come back four hours later at 3:30pm. What a joke. I had children to pick up from school, so attending four hours later was impossible.

I asked if I could be booked in for the following week instead, and I was told they had no availability at all for the next two weeks. Completely unacceptable and honestly disgusting.

To make matters worse, while I was there another patient was arguing with staff because the doctor refused to see her child despite them having an appointment as well. That alone shows this GP treats multiple patients the same way.

This is not the first bad experience either. On previous occasions the staff have been extremely rude. When complaining over the phone in the past, I was told things like:
“Why don’t you change GP?”
“Why don’t you move out of Oldham?”
Disgusting attitude. Completely unprofessional. Shows clearly that this GP surgery does not care at all about its patients.

today for the second time to book an appt but received an attitude from the receptionists who then walked off without addressing the issue simply because she “does not want to entertain this.”
My dad (English is not his first language) tried to go first time and they sent him away with a link to book online.
I couldn’t book online after 2pm which is something they had never mentioned but instead said i “went online at the wrong time.” I work a full time job as a doctor with on-call commitments, what’s “the wrong time” sorry? Regardless, I tried numerous times to get him an appt.
On walking in today, the receptionist acknowledged he had come before and started to declare his medical situation out loud. I addressed it and said they were breaching confidentiality after which they accused me of being loud and tried to blame me instead. I was very unhappy with the receptionists and told them I would put in a formal complaint. My second concern was, now that they’ve already plastered my dad’s business everywhere, what can we do to avoid this happening with others and suggested maybe go to a separate room and discuss? They weren’t having any of it, she was very rude, tried to conveniently switch the situation onto me and said had we called there wouldn’t be no breach to which I replied there is a subset of patients that cannot use online booking or prefer to come in person for whatever reason (maybe they’re elderly?!). I will put in a written complaint to the practice manager and have changed practices.
Please don’t go to this practice.
